content.comment_body: Hello, I am working with a [product_name] PLC ([article_no]) and would like to set and read the current date and time from the PLC to an HMI. Thank you in advance. Regards, [user_name]
Hi, The [product_name] uses a time and date format that differs from what an HMI typically requires. I don't believe it's possible to interface directly.
Hello, Even if the formats differ, I can convert it as needed. I just need to know where I can retrieve the current time. Thanks and regards, [user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: Participants are trying to obtain the current date and time from a [product_name] PLC ([article_no]) and present or modify this data on an HMI panel. There is uncertainty about compatibility due to differing time/date formats between the PLC and HMI, resulting in confusion about whether this functionality is supported and how to achieve it. A major pain point is unclear documentation about how the PLC shares its date/time with external devices like HMIs.
analysis.user_expectations: Users want to be able to set and read the current date and time from the [product_name] PLC and make this data available on their HMI panel, regardless of any discrepancies in data format.
